purpose: Independent browser checks of mode exclusivity, exact sonority counts, source/IPA exploration and explicit reading policy. Not a stylistic-intention or universal phonetic accuracy score.

tests.name: isolated artifact has the manifest hash and starts with both modes off
Sonorités deactivates colors while preserving their saved category preferences
each verse has distinct alliteration and assonance groups
Racine has exactly five /s/ in five words in each verse
selecting /s/ marks the c of ces, exact IPA units, and only its own verse
same sound second click clears only that verse selection
one selected sound per verse and independent selection on another verse
activating colors deactivates Sonorités and preserves transcription/preferences
both modes can be off without retaining sonority marks
strict phoneme distinctions: tache tâche tache tâche
strict phoneme distinctions: mettre maître mettre maître
strict phoneme distinctions: fée fait fée fait
strict phoneme distinctions: brin brun brin brun
strict phoneme distinctions: cote côte cote côte
strict phoneme distinctions: jeune jeûne jeune jeûne
nasality and duration marks never become independent sounds
semi-consonant convention: j
semi-consonant convention: w
semi-consonant convention: ɥ
silent letters and doubled spellings do not inflate consonant counts
realized liaison is counted once and omitted optional liaison is absent
contextual denasalization contributes the oral vowel actually retained
repeated identical source words count as separate positions
clitic decomposition does not inflate the graphical word count
hyphenated compound remains one graphical word
nonlexical hyphenated spelling groups the engine internal tokens into one source word
numeric expansion preserves one graphical word per number
grouped numerals are graphical words rather than space-separated digit blocks
separate verses and blank lines cannot create cross-line repetitions
each category can independently have no repetition
shared grapheme selection marks x completely but only selected /k/ in IPA
opaque number alignment retains exact IPA highlighting without inventing source spans
unknown pronunciations remain marked as hypotheses in sonority results
canonically equivalent accents yield identical counts and preserve source exactly
switching view mode never silently changes the explicit reading policy
explicit poetic alternatives update actual phones and their repetitions
